cards.card_text: Three times a year, the Israelites are to celebrate a feast to God: the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Harvest and the Feast of Ingathering.
cards.verse_text: And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
cards.snippet: And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from…

cards.card_text: Then come rules for Israel's year: the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, the Feast of Ingathering, the firstborn that belong to the LORD, and all the males appearing before Him three times a year.
cards.verse_text: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
cards.snippet: …Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
